items.title: American Spring :: S/T (1972)
items.summary: Constantly meandering in copyright turmoil that renders it inaccessible, 1972's lone eponymous record by American Spring (sisters Marilyn Wilson and Diane Rovell, formerly of girl group The Honeys) is an obtusely captivating slice of baroque pop. A production of Marilyn's husband Brian Wilson along with consummate Beach Boys engineer Stephen Desper, the source material culls tracks from the band's classic Sunflower as well as the The Shirelles, old country standards and the Goffin-King and Tommy Roe songbooks. items.title: Elastic Melody now does bass and DFAM-style percussion, too (Mac, iOS)
items.summary: Elastic Melody was already a go-to melody generator for Mac, iPad, and iPhone, with an internal synth engine inspired by the brilliant Dave Smith Evolver and the ability to output to other apps or hardware gear. Now it gains new Pitch and Filter Drive modes, so it can also be your bassline maker and percussion source. The post Elastic Melody now does bass and DFAM-style percussion, too (Mac, iOS) appeared first on CDM Create Digital Music .
